data.one_liner: Library for generating legal chess moves, tracking game state, and converting between FEN/PGN.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure Dart implementation of chess move generation, game state maintenance, and FEN/PGN conversion. It has no external dependencies and supports null safety.
use_when: Implement chess logic in a Dart app
Create a chess engine or AI
avoid_when: You need a ready‑made UI board widget
strengths: Null safety and modern Dart support
Comprehensive test suite and performance improvements
